layouts.name: Monogram Eights, Offset
layouts.note: the rings turned half a step, the way the LV ball staggers its rows: nothing sits directly under anything, and every step is 2.33 mm

layouts.name: Monogram Eights
layouts.note: three rings of eight in columns, every step the same: 2.20 mm on a 7 mm ball, nothing touching

layouts.name: Monogram Eights, Big OM
layouts.note: the rings pushed out to make room for a 3.10 mm OM; the steps are no longer equal

layouts.name: Monogram Eights, Full Size
layouts.note: the OM at 3.54 mm with every step equal, which a 7 mm ball cannot hold - this one wants 9.5 mm

layouts.name: Monogram Grid
layouts.note: the reference: four OM round the middle, outlined crosses on the cardinals, squared and circled crosses alternating on the diagonals, 925 at the foot

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Four Motifs
layouts.note: the same without the circled cross: squared on every diagonal

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Swapped
layouts.note: the same lattice with the two crosses the other way round

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Three Crosses
layouts.note: outlined on the cardinals, squared above and below, circled round the middle

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Plain
layouts.note: every cross the small solid one, so the OM carries the whole pattern

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Big OM
layouts.note: the OM as large as the lattice will take, crosses eased back

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Quiet OM
layouts.note: a smaller OM, the crosses given their full drawn size

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Crowned
layouts.note: a ring of small crosses between the pattern and the hole, top and bottom

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Two OM
layouts.note: OM on two opposite faces only, circled crosses on the other two

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, 925 Band
layouts.note: 925 four times round the middle instead of once at the foot

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Bare
layouts.note: four OM and 925, polished ball between them

layouts.name: Monogram Grid, Six OM
layouts.note: OM on every face the hole leaves free, 925 moved into the pattern
